description: List the builtin module type names in alphabetical order. Defaults to a terse index; pass detail: full for default-config ports/controls and explicit per-type errors. Optional types filter accepts 1–64 exact names; unknown names fail. Payload limit: 64 KiB; narrow oversized queries. Use describe_module for a supplied config.

TypeDetail.description: Requested catalog detail. Full details describe each type's default config.

oneOf.description: Names only, without constructing any modules.
Ports and controls, or an explicit per-type inspection error.

detail.description: Defaults to index; request full explicitly for default-config metadata.

types.description: Optional exact names (1–64); unknown names fail the request. Omit for all.

name: describe_module_types
title: Describe Module Types
